# acme-items

Generated TypeScript client for **Acme Items API** (1.2.3), talking to `https://api.acme.test`.

```bash
npm install acme-items
```

```ts
import { Client } from "acme-items";

const client = new Client();
const result = await client.createItem(...);
```

Errors throw subclasses of `ApiError`; rate limits retry automatically, honoring `Retry-After`. Model properties use the wire names the API sends, so a decoded response needs no translation step.

Requires Node 18+ (or any runtime with a global `fetch`).

## Methods

- `createItem` — `POST /v1/items`: Create an item.
- `deleteItem` — `DELETE /v1/items/{id}`: Delete an item.
- `getItem` — `GET /v1/items/{id}`: Get one item.
- `getStats` — `GET /v1/stats`: Get stats.
- `listItems` — `GET /v1/items`: List items.
